name: 16x2 Character LCD with I2C
description: Like a digital nametag! Displays 32 letters/numbers over a simple two-wire I2C communication bus.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a digital nametag! Displays 32 letters/numbers over a simple two-wire I2C communication bus.
wiringGuidance: Connect GND (Dark Slate) to GND, VCC (Red) to 5V, SDA (Blue) to Arduino pin A4, and SCL (Blue) to pin A5.
commonMistakes: Not adjusting the blue contrast potentiometer on the back I2C backpack—characters appear invisible!

miniExperiment.title: I2C Hello World Display
miniExperiment.circuit: GND to GND, VCC to 5V, SDA to A4 (Blue), SCL to A5 (Blue).
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The 16x2 LCD backlight illuminates and displays 'Monster Lab!' on line 1 and 'System Online' on line 2.
